environment: Official Playwright 1.64.1 noble Docker image; Linux automation, not physical iPhone Safari
comparison: Same plain public URL, fresh storage, viewport, assets and service-worker isolation; only browser context persistence changed
finding: The ephemeral WebKit context exposed OPFS but rejected getDirectory. The old navigation-only wait hid the early handled storage failure. The same public service-worker and COOP/COEP startup worked with a fresh persistent profile.
limits: Does not establish physical iPhone or Safari Private Browsing behavior.
Separate from the independently reproduced Iroh Join relay failure.
Profiles existed only inside disposable containers and were not exported.
